template.name: Hammer & Shooting Star
template.entry_long: close > open and (open - low) >= {p0} * (close - open) and (high - close) <= (close - open)
template.notes: Hammer candle: lower shadow >= 2x body, upper shadow <= body. Long WickFactor=0.9, MaxOppositeWickFactor=0.45, MinBodyRangePct=0.2. No fixed stop; exit on prior low break.
